name: mame02
title: MAME 0.2 (DJGPP + Allegro, 1997)
_doc: 0.1's successor, seven drivers instead of four: Mr. Do, Crazy Climber and Congo Bongo join Pac-Man, Pengo, Crush Roller and Lady Bug. Worth having beside 0.1 rather than instead of it -- two releases of the same program, three months apart, is a compiler test that no single snapshot gives.
_units: The makefile's OBJS list, in its order. obj/osdepend.o has its own rule pointing at src/msdos/msdos.c -- MAME's own DOS backend, which is compiled rather than replaced.
_include: The makefile's -Isrc -Isrc/z80, plus src/msdos for the osdepend rule.
_defines: The makefile passes -DX86_ASM -DLSB_FIRST. X86_ASM is NOT set here: it selects the x86 assembly path, the same choice as Quake's id386=0 and Heretic's #ifndef __WATCOMC__.
